title: Visualize the local lov-skill-creator runtime contract
description: The user supplied the canonical local Skill Creator instructions and asked for a reusable way to understand and trust a Skill. The extractor separated external activation from eight internal steps, preserved line-bound actions and criteria, identified deterministic scripts and validation assets, and produced a restrained zh-first standalone trust brief whose use case, transformation, outcome, and trust boundary are readable without interacting with Mermaid.

items: Its top-level SKILL.md, linked references, scripts, and runtime manifest

prompt: 给定一个本地 skill，或者该 skill 的路径，然后要能生成整个 skill 运行逻辑的可视化图，也许可以考虑 Mermaid 的格式。

evidence.remaining_diagnostic: Three packaged historical or test files are inventoried as unlinked; no declared runtime resource is missing.
